about: Real PDFs downloaded by a real Axcess scan of https://hr.umich.edu/ (max 20 pages, public defaults, 2026-11-17), including files those pages link to on www.dol.gov, menopause.org and www.ssa.gov: 28 distinct files (by SHA-256), 21 from hr.umich.edu. Chosen when veraPDF was being tried: every file where pypdf failed a check or veraPDF failed a rule outside 5-1, 7.21.4.x, 7.18.4-2 and 6.2-1, plus 12 chosen across publishers where both passed. Per file: does it have a problem that stops or misleads a screen reader or keyboard user (has_reader_problem; null = the labeller was unsure, not scored), and which of Axcess's checks it should fail (expected_failed_checks), read from the labeller's reader_problems. Judged by an agent inspecting each file's structure, not by a person with a screen reader. Limits: one site, mostly one publisher's forms; few failures per check (field_no_name 3 files, link_no_description 2, untagged_text 2, no_alt_text 0, table_cells_misplaced 1, formula_no_description 0); and the four structure checks were tuned on these same files (the 5% header and footer band, MCIDs no tag refers to, parent-tree Artifact elements), so their scores here are not independent.
